cards.d: When a bad thing is acute, it is very severe and intense.
cards.e: When she fell out of the tree, the girl felt an acute pain in her arm.

cards.d: Aggression is behavior that is mean or violent to others.
cards.e: The problem was only made worse by Mark’s aggression.

cards.d: A banquet is a grand formal dinner.
cards.e: Both families brought a lot of food for the wedding banquet.

cards.d: A biography is an account of someone’s life that is written by someone else.
cards.e: We read a biography about Charles Darwin in science class.

cards.d: To boost something means to increase or improve it.
cards.e: Lowering prices boosts customers’ interest in shopping.

cards.d: To clap means to hit one’s hands together to express pleasure or get attention.
cards.e: After the speech, everyone in the crowd clapped their hands for the speaker.

cards.d: To compel someone to do something means to force them to do it.
cards.e: Traffic signs compel drivers to drive safely.

cards.d: The dominance of a person is their state of being more powerful than others.
cards.e: Large gorillas hit their chests to express their dominance over others.

cards.d: When something is gorgeous, it is very pleasing and attractive.
cards.e: The girl picked out a gorgeous dress to wear to the dance.

cards.d: When something is inevitable, it is certain to happen or cannot be avoided.
cards.e: It is inevitable that the days will get longer in the summer.

cards.d: A legacy is an effect that exists because of a person or thing in the past.
cards.e: The legacy of the ancient Egyptians can be seen in their monuments.

cards.d: A masterpiece is a very good painting, novel, movie, or other work of art.
cards.e: The Arc de Triomphe is considered a masterpiece in the world of architecture.

cards.d: If there are multiple things, there are many of them.
cards.e: When the stunt went wrong, the man suffered multiple injuries.

cards.d: To narrate a story means to write about it or read it aloud.
cards.e: This story was written by John, but Aaron is narrating it to the crowd.

cards.d: When something is notorious, it is well-known because of something bad.
cards.e: This area of town is notorious for gang activity.

cards.d: When something is outdated, it is old and no longer useful in modern time.
cards.e: Tape players are becoming outdated because of digital music.

cards.d: When a thing is talked about overall, the whole thing is considered.
cards.e: Overall, the party was a huge success.

cards.d: A partiality is a tendency to prefer one thing to another.
cards.e: She has a partiality for walking to school instead of driving.

cards.d: When an act is spontaneous, it is not planned. It happens suddenly.
cards.e: My wife made a spontaneous decision to buy a new sofa while I was at work.

cards.d: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.
cards.e: My best virtue is forgiveness.
